_comment: 🧩️ This plugin's contribution to the repository test platform. The framework discovers this file by convention (`testContributionDirName` in 🔣️taxonomy.json) and never names this plugin or any standard it owns. It additionally claims the shared test-only Python references of the Eurocode artifacts EN 1990-1999 (one claim per library, pinned in the root `pyproject.toml` test group), registers the five Eurocode tolerance profiles and hosts the schema-first oracle harness at `🏃️harness`.

oracles.rationale: Independent open-source implementation of EN 1992-1-1:2004 constitutive laws, design strengths, shear and fibre section analysis. Delegated: M_Rd, V_Rd, creep and strengths; NA-DE parameters are passed in from cited fixtures, never read from the library.

engine.implementation: fib structuralcodes EN 1992-1-1:2004 and fib Model Code implementation

packages.role: Mesh generator used by structuralcodes; compiled cp314 wheels for linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, win32-x64.

oracles.rationale: Second reinforced-concrete section implementation: ultimate bending, M-N interaction and cracked properties through fibre integration with the EN 1992 parabola-rectangle law. Shares the sectionproperties kernel, so it is one family with it.

engine.implementation: concreteproperties fibre and finite element reinforced concrete section analysis

packages.role: Triangle mesh generator used by sectionproperties; compiled cp314 wheels for linux-x64, darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, win32-x64.

oracles.rationale: Finite element section constants (A, I, J, Iw, shear areas, plastic moduli) for EN 1993, EN 1994, EN 1995 and EN 1999 sections, independent of the closed-form tables.

packages.role: Triangle mesh generator used by sectionproperties; compiled cp314 wheels for linux-x64, darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, win32-x64.

oracles.rationale: Clause-numbered formula objects for EN 1992-1-1, EN 1993 and EN 1997; per-function coverage is listed in the library coverage audit.

packages.role: Transitive hard dependency of blue-prints, never imported by oracles.

oracles.rationale: Symbolic re-derivation and lambdified evaluation of closed forms (bearing factors, Euler, spectra) so the oracle never reuses the Rust expression.
Raw bearing capacity, pile and settlement formulas; no EN 1997 partial factor sets. GPL-3.0 is acceptable because it is test-only and never linked into shipped code, the same basis as anastruct.
Independent 3D finite element frame solver: internal forces, reactions and deflections of beams and portals that validate the mechanics kernel and the load arrangement coefficients of EN 1990-1999.
Independent 2D direct-stiffness frame solver (GPL-3.0, test-only, never linked into shipped code) for the same beam and portal cases as PyNiteFEA.

Independent formulations of Eurocode clauses no Eurocode library covers: strain-compatibility flexure by quadrature, Ayrton-Perry roots, Euler eigenproblems, FORM design points, EN 1990 combination enumeration, composite plastic neutral axes, shear-building eigenproblems, Janssen slice equilibrium, Boussinesq integration and influence functions. Reference quantities are computed with SciPy, never with the Rust expressions.

engine.implementation: SciPy quadrature, root finding, constrained minimisation and generalized eigenproblems on NumPy

oracleHostPackages.rationale: 📕️ The ONE independent Python implementation of the norm mutation vocabulary, put on the generated Python host's import path so all fifteen subset adapters IMPORT it instead of each holding a byte-identical copy. It is in-repo source (`path`), never a distribution, so nothing is provisioned and the dependency ratchet classifies it as neither production nor third-party. The fifteen subsets differ in exactly four things — kind list, specification vectors, example document, envelope token — and those four stay with the subset; the derivation rules the engine implements are one committed document for all fifteen, so implementing them fifteen times would have been fifteen copies of a single reading, not fifteen readings. Declared here rather than per subset for the same reason the Rust entry above is: an `oracleHostPackage` reaches a case through its owner's ANCESTORS, and a case owned by `🗿️artifacts/<artifact>` is not a descendant of the subset that declares the catalog.

comparisonProfiles.description: Resistances and utilisations against a library: relative 1e-4, 2e-3 where the library rounds a constant.
Integration or finite element reference: relative 5e-3, convergence checked by refinement.
Two engineering methods: relative spread stated per case, default 3e-2.
Cited normative table values: exact equality after unit conversion.
